color.note: Two layers: brand primitives (carbon → paper, vermilion) and the semantic tokens UI code uses. Build with the semantic ones; primitives are for identity work (logo, cover, social, print).

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Brand black. The dark theme's ground, the app icon, the reverse logo's field. Pair with paper.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Raised black: dark cards, the proposal cover band, case-study data panels.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Warm grey for secondary marks on paper (4-tone illustration, chart gridline labels).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm neutral block: cover relief, chart secondary series on paper, imagery mats.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand off-white. The light theme's ground; ink sits on it at 16:1.

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: Lightest paper: raised cards and inputs in the light theme.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: The mark's ink — the three nuqtas of the logo, the signature rhombus, a full-stop nuqta, cover blocks. Graphic only (3:1+ on surface in both themes); never body text on paper — use nuqta for that.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Ink, ink-muted, ink-faint and nuqta text all read on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, menus, table rows at rest.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: code blocks, table header, the sidebar ground, skeleton loaders. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted bands (a dark section on a light page, the tooltip). Text on it is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card and table borders. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons): 3:1+ on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (14:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, table headers — on any surface (5.6:1+).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels, on surface and surface-raised only (4.8:1+).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse and on carbon/paper bands.

tokens.name: nuqta
tokens.usage: Interactive accent: the primary button fill, links, active tab and nav indicators, selected rows' marker. As text, on surface, surface-raised and nuqta-soft (4.6:1+).

tokens.name: nuqta-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind nuqta text: a selected row, an active nav item, a 'new' badge.

tokens.name: on-nuqta
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on a nuqta fill (the primary button): 6:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, live, passing. A blue-teal, off the red–green axis so it never relies on hue against danger. As text on surface or success-soft; always with a check icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, not broken. Text on surface or warning-soft; always with the alert icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. A crimson-rose kept apart from the brand vermilion: never use nuqta or vermilion to mean error. Text on surface or danger-soft; always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error banners, invalid-field hints, destructive confirmations.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (2px, 2px offset): ink on every surface, so focus never reads as the accent or as an error.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links — an alias of nuqta, underlined 1px at rest.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and drawers.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Tight, large, few words. A display line may end in a vermilion nuqta instead of a full stop.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the website hero, the proposal cover, the case-study title.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers on marketing pages; slide titles.

styles.name: display-md
styles.sample: Built for how Nakheel actually works.
styles.usage: Case-study chapter titles, social posts, pull quotes.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Product and reading text. Sentence case everywhere.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title inside products; document H1.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles, table titles, form groups.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We spent two weeks inside the warehouse before we wrote a line of code.
styles.usage: Marketing lead paragraphs, case-study body, proposals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Approvals now take one tap instead of three emails.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Hints, table cells in dense views, captions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tabs, nav items.

groups.name: Arabic
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, set looser than Latin: Arabic needs the extra line height for its ascenders, descenders and dots. Never letter-spaced; never condensed.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Arabic hero and cover lines; pairs with display-xl/lg.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: قضينا أسبوعين داخل المستودع قبل أن نكتب سطرًا واحدًا من الكود.
styles.usage: Arabic UI and reading text (one pixel larger than Latin body).

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: The builder's voice: numbers, codes, eyebrows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above headings, section indices (01, 02…), slide footers.

spacing.note: The nuqta is the unit. In calligraphy the dot measures every letter; here 1 nuqta = 4px and every gap is a whole number of nuqtas.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 1 nuqta. Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button inline padding (sm); list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), form field gaps, the mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (default), gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section; the desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a product page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room; proposal cover margins.

radius.note: Precise, not soft. Corners are nearly square; the brand's distinct corner is the cut (a 45° chamfer from the nuqta's angle), applied in CSS, not by radius.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Marketing blocks, images, the cover band, tables.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, tooltips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, menus, modals.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Mobile sheets and large mobile cards only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the switch track. Nothing else is round.

shadow.note: Borders do the work; shadows only for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, the modal.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px ground gap, then a solid 2px ink ring (16:1).

duration.note: Motion is fast and deliberate: the press of a mark, not a float.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: The press: button active state, the nuqta stamp's compress.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, tab indicator move, tooltip in.

tokens.name: duration-trace
tokens.usage: The trace: a line drawing, a panel forming, a toast leaving its mark.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Marketing reveals only; never in product UI.

tokens.name: ease-mark
tokens.usage: Default: fast out, precise landing. Most UI motion.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Accelerating in — the moment before a mark lands.

tokens.name: ease-trace
tokens.usage: Symmetric, for lines that draw themselves.

breakpoint.note: Content-first; the grid changes at three widths.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: 4 → 8 columns; mobile gutter 16px → 24px.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: 8 → 12 columns; sidebar becomes persistent in products.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Max container reached; margins grow instead.

layout.note: 12 columns, 32px gutter at desktop. Marketing text never spans more than 7 columns.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Marketing and proposal content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of reading text.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Product sidebar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Product top bar and marketing nav.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky nav and table headers.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim and modal.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and tooltips.
